title: A Wonderful Way to Experience Barcelona
text:
David is an experienced and knowledgeable guide who catered perfectly to our interests and requests. Enjoying oysters with cava and cured ham with red wine at the market was an absolutely wonderful experience!

His extensive knowledge of the city’s history also made our walk much more meaningful and enjoyable.

We had a fantastic time and would highly recommend this tour to anyone!
